visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: A Map Instead of Two Parallel Lists
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Two lists, one with the words and one with the counts, are kept in step with indexOf. Use a LinkedHashMap, which also keeps the first-seen order. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A map associates each word with its count directly, so there are no parallel lists to keep in step, and lookups are fast instead of scanning the list with indexOf.
